text: 记者获悉，中国人民银行江西省分行原党委书记、行长陈建新已接棒任咏梅，出任中国人民银行征信管理局局长。 公开信息显示，陈建新是西南财经大学经济学博士。在赴江西任职前，她历任《金融时报》首席编辑、中央银行资产处处长、货币金银局（保卫局）副局长等职，兼具理论功底与实践经验。（21财经）
text_en: Reporters have learned that Chen Jianxin, former Party secretary and president of the PBOC Jiangxi Provincial Branch, has succeeded Ren Yongmei as director of the PBOC Credit Reference Management Bureau. Public information shows Chen Jianxin holds a doctorate in economics from Southwestern University of Finance and Economics. Before taking up her post in Jiangxi, she served as chief editor of Financial News, director of the Central Bank Asset Division, and deputy director of the Currency, Gold and Silver Bureau (Security Bureau), combining theoretical foundation with practical experience. (21st Century Business Herald)
